title: Yellowed Flaky Norwegian Ladyfingers Trifle
description: A tangy and flaky Norwegian dessert featuring savoiardi ladyfingers, perfect for those looking for a lacto-vegetarian friendly treat. This nostalgic dish is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth.
instructions: In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, mix the granulated sugar and egg custard until well combined.
Add the sugar and custard mixture to the whipped cream and mix until smooth.
Dip each ladyfinger into the mixture for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Spread a layer of raspberry jam over the ladyfingers.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top.
Garnish with fresh raspberries and a sprinkle of confectioners sugar.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle with lemon zest.
